bio_am: Տարօնի նշանաւոր հայդուկ, 1904-ի Սասնոյ ապստամբութեան ղեկավարներէն։ Մահացած է Երեւան՝ 1954 Յունիս 19-ին։
bio_en: Smbat Boroyan was a son of Taron and one of the renowned haiduks of the Sasun mountains. He was among the leaders of the 1904 Sasun uprising alongside Andranik, Hrayr, Sebouh and Gevorg Chavush. During the First World War he commanded volunteers and was later known as General Smbat, photographed with Yeghishe Pahlavuni and Nado Grigorian. He remained in Soviet Armenia and died in Yerevan on 19 June 1954, his death unreported by the Soviet press.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Death year from Haratch 26 Aug 1954 reprint of a Hairenik editorial of 5 August.
